attr.title: Crash Team Racing: Turbocharged
attr.desc: A native PC port of Crash Team Racing, rebuilt from the decompiled source, with higher precision rendering, smoother frame rates and quality of life options.
attr.inst: Requires your own NTSC-U (US) Crash Team Racing disc image (SCUS-94426) as a raw .bin with 2352-byte sectors. A .iso does not work. Copy the .bin to ports/ctrturbocharged/assets/.
